provenance: Source hashes and independent autumn numerical overlap verified in GitHub Actions, with no new Fingrid calls.
boundaries: Archived source-complete means both Fingrid 124 and 74 have original 15-minute readings on every interval of the listed UTC date. It does not establish Finnish electrical network feasibility.
Known missing original consumption readings remain source unknown, never zero or inferred from adjacent 15-minute intervals.
305 days are not covered by the imported historic archives. This is an archive coverage statement, not proof that Fingrid lacks observations on those days.
The original 2025 source is NOT a 365-day complete dataset. Do not annualize the sample energy nor represent separate blocks as one continuous battery simulation.
The original data do not provide 2030 forecasts, import rights, operator-confirmed substation connection capacity, or price projections.
